args: ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; [ -z "$ROOT" ] && ROOT=$(cat ~/.claude/channels/rx-claude-matrix-bridge/plugin-root 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$ROOT" ] && ROOT="$PWD"; if [ -f "$ROOT/dist/server.js" ]; then exec node "$ROOT/dist/server.js"; elif [ -f "$ROOT/server.js" ]; then exec node "$ROOT/server.js"; elif [ -f "$ROOT/server.ts" ]; then cd "$ROOT" && exec npx --yes tsx server.ts; elif [ -f "$ROOT/../dist/server.js" ]; then exec node "$ROOT/../dist/server.js"; else echo "matrix-bridge: cannot locate server (ROOT=$ROOT). Tried: $ROOT/dist/server.js, $ROOT/server.js, $ROOT/server.ts, $ROOT/../dist/server.js. Reinstall the plugin or run 'npm run build' in the repo." >&2; exit 1; fi
